cards.rules_text_en: Attack; deal 1 Heart of damage unless blocked.
Attack; deal 1 damage. If it succeeds, the target discards 1 card.
Attack; deal 1 damage and ask the target to reveal their last played Action card, if any.
Attack; deal 1 damage. If the target has 2+ Suspicion, gain Behavior Evidence if they have a recorded qualifying action.
Reaction: prevent 1 damage to yourself.
Reaction: prevent 1 damage to yourself and remove 1 of your Suspicion.
Reaction: prevent 1 damage to any target; playable only if that target did not defend.
Reaction: prevent 1 damage to yourself; gain Behavior Evidence on the attacker if they have a qualifying public action.
Gain Behavior Evidence against a player with a recorded Attack or Noisy action. Otherwise, gain none.
Gain Clue Evidence on a player; privately inspect 1 random card from their hand, if any.
Privately inspect 1 random card in another player's hand; draw 1 card.
Gain Clue Evidence on a player; ask them to show their most recently played Action card, if any.
Give another player 1 Suspicion. **Noisy.**
Remove up to 2 of your Suspicion. **Noisy** (then gain 1 back).
Two other Active players each discard 1 card. **Noisy.**
Swap 1 randomly selected card from your hand with 1 from another player's hand.
Restore 1 Heart to yourself or any surviving player, including a Cornered player.
Draw 2 cards and discard 1 card.
Reaction: if you are Cornered and no accusation was made, recover to 1 Heart immediately.
Restore 1 of your Hearts and remove 1 Suspicion.
Choose yourself or another Active player; the next damage they would take before your next turn is prevented.
Gain Clue Evidence against one player and inspect 1 random card from their hand; they may discard 1 card to prevent the inspection (but not the Evidence).
All players show their Suspicion markers; draw 1 card.
Reaction to investigation: prevent someone from looking at your hand; Evidence from their card still applies.
